cohort: 100 pregnant women diagnosed with obstetric cholestasis at a tertiary railway hospital in India between June 2018 and December 2019.
finding: Obstetric cholestasis is significantly associated with maternal complications like PIH and adverse perinatal outcomes such as NICU admissions and low Apgar scores.
mod_finding: Out of the 100 women in the study, 26% had an elective LUCS, 28% had an emergency LUCS, and 46% had a vaginal delivery.
